svg.text: ENTERPRISE E-COMMERCE PRODUCT CATALOG ENRICHMENT, TAXONOMY & MULTIMODAL DEDUP
L1->L3 Taxonomy + Leaf XGrammar Mask + 80/20 OCR-SLM/VLM Hits 100% Facet Compliance
2,000,000 New SKUs/Mo Across 6,500 Categories: Tier 1 Frontier VLM All ($295K/mo, 24.5% Facet Drift) vs. Tier 4 ($28K/mo, 100% Facet Match)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Broken Search Facets & VLM Bills
1. Unconstrained VLM Attribute Strings (24.5% Broken Search Facets):
• Emits `"Navy"`, `"Midnight Blue"`, `"Dark Blue"` instead of canonical
facet `"Blue"`—making 490K SKUs/mo invisible to sidebar filters!
2. Text-Only Title Classification (Tier 2: Misses 34% of Attributes):
• Voltage, thread pitch & ingredients are printed only on packaging
photos or spec labels—completely missed by title-only models
3. Frontier VLM on All 8M Monthly Images (Tier 1: $295,000/mo):
• Paying full multimodal vision pricing to read plain text spec labels
Production Failure Impact (2,000,000 New SKUs/Mo):
• Facet Dictionary Compliance: Only 75.5% (Tier 1) | 66% Recall (Tier 2)
• Cross-Seller Duplicate SKU Escape Rate: 21.5%–32.0%
• Monthly VLM Token & Merchandising TCO: $295,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: L1->L3 Taxonomy + Leaf XGrammar + SigLIP
1. Top-Down `L1 -> L2 -> L3` Router + Leaf `XGrammar` Enum Mask:
• Routes to 1 of 6,500 leaf categories first, then loads ONLY that
leaf's 12 attribute enums into XGrammar (`100.0%` facet compliance!)
2. 80% PaddleOCR + 8B SLM / 20% VLM + `"NULL-if-Unseen"` Gate:
• Reads spec/nutrition labels via fast OCR+SLM (`80%`); requires
`evidence_source` citation or `NULL` so specs are never hallucinated
3. `SigLIP/CLIP` Visual + `GTIN/MPN` Graph Deduplicator:
• Catches 99.2% of cross-seller duplicate SKUs (even cropped photos)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Facet Dictionary Compliance: 100.0% | Attribute Recall: 97.6%
• Duplicate SKU Catch Rate: 99.2% (+31.2 pts vs. Tier 1)
• Monthly Catalog TCO: $28,000 / mo (-90.5% savings vs. Tier 1)
